Ripstop’s Git adapter module provides a thin, consistent interface for checks that need to inspect repository files, staged content, and diffs. It interacts primarily with developers and CI jobs running checks, and depends on the local Git CLI to query repository state. It also reads files from the working tree and hook scripts (commit-msg) from disk to support commit-time validation workflows.

```mermaid
C4Context
title Ripstop Git Adapter (Git.ts) - C4 Context

Person(dev, "Developer", "Runs Ripstop checks locally, stages changes, creates commits")
Person(ci, "CI Pipeline", "Executes Ripstop checks in automated builds")

System_Boundary(ripstop, "Ripstop Checks Tooling") {
  System(gitAdapter, "Git Adapter Module (Git.ts)", "Runs git commands and returns file entries, contents, and diffs for checks")
}

System_Ext(gitCli, "Git CLI", "git executable available on PATH (rev-parse, ls-files, diff, show)")
System_Ext(fileSystem, "File System", "Working tree files and .git/hooks/commit-msg")
System_Ext(osProcess, "OS Process Runtime", "Spawns child processes (execFile) to invoke git")

Rel(dev, gitAdapter, "Runs checks; requests file lists, staged content, diffs")
Rel(ci, gitAdapter, "Runs checks; requests file lists, diffs for validation")
Rel(gitAdapter, gitCli, "Invokes git commands to compute repo root, file sets, diffs")
Rel(gitAdapter, fileSystem, "Reads working tree files and commit message hook file")
Rel(gitAdapter, osProcess, "Spawns subprocesses to run git")
```

The Git adapter’s primary dependency is the external Git CLI, invoked via child_process.execFile, to compute repository root (rev-parse), enumerate tracked files (ls-files), and derive staged or ref-based change sets (diff --cached, diff ref...HEAD). For content, it reads working tree files directly from the file system and uses git show :path to extract staged versions. It also reads the commit-msg hook file to obtain commit message text for validation. Errors are normalized through a shared InvalidOperationError.
